issues.description: The problem statement and UML refer to a method named printFarmSong() to implement the song, but both the template and the provided solution use a public method named singFarmSong() (and a private singFarmSongVerse()). This name/signature mismatch between the specification and the code can confuse students about which method to implement and test against.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across specification and code. Either update the problem statement and UML to require singFarmSong(), or add/rename a printFarmSong() method in the template/solution (e.g., implement printFarmSong() as a public wrapper that calls singFarmSong(), or rename singFarmSong() to printFarmSong() in template and solution). This alignment will remove ambiguity for students.
